newsitem.title: USA: Graphic sees operating results beating estimates.
newsitem.headline: Graphic sees operating results beating estimates.

text.p: Graphic Industries Inc said Monday it expects earnings for fiscal year ended January 31, 1997, before a first quarter restructuring charge, to exceed the $1.11 a share primary earnings concensus estimate by analysts.
It said it also expects to report revenues for the fiscal year exceeding $436 million, compared to $417 million the previous year. Its primary earnings for the previous year was $0.98, it said.
It said it expects to report results for the fourth quarter and the full fiscal year in mid-March.
Mark Pope, chairman and chief executive officer, said the company is currently evaluating serveral promising acquisition candidates.
"These efforts could bear fruit over the next several months to a year, he said.

Recently, the printing and graphic communications services acquired Presstar Printing Corp, making an entry into the Baltimore-Washington market. It has also announced it would acquire Monroe Graphics Inc in Rochester, N.Y.

"Graphic's plan is ultimately to enter every major market in the U.S. where our company does not now have a presence," he said. Targeted for expansion through acquisitions are New York City, Chicago, St. Louis, Denver, Kansas City, Louisville and Phoenix, he said.
